title: How to read your BPCL (MAK) invoice
subtitle: Lube plant invoice. Each product has a second line showing its DISCOUNT.
rows: 01. MAK DIAMOND-1 Ltr Case (12 Ltr Case)

steps.text: Quantity: type the L29 number (litres) and choose Litres. PetroMath converts it: 40 L of 5 Ltr cans = 8 cans. Do not type litres as pieces.
Amount: type the Taxable Value on the product's first line (before discount).
Discount: type the DISCOUNT amount on the second line (without the minus sign).
Cash discount: type CASH DISCOUNT from the bottom once. PetroMath spreads it across the products before GST, just like BPCL does.
Printed total: type TOTAL AMOUNT. You can close the invoice only when it matches.

hints.gross: BPCL: "Taxable Value" on the product line
hints.discount: BPCL: the "DISCOUNT" line under the product
hints.tax_type: BPCL plant invoices are CGST + SGST
